name: DPP Buyer
description: Verifies a manufacturer's UNTP Digital Product Passport and its Make records, and requests its Digital Conformity Credential.
summary: Buyer wallet for workflows/dpp-workflow.md on the NOOP trust framework. Reading published passports, Make records and DCCs needs no configuration; its one verifier, dcc_disclosure, requests the manufacturer's unpublished Digital Conformity Credential over WMP.
